raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm, full CUDA graph capture can fail during server startup for mixed-attention models when a later metadata builder reads a query length of zero. The root cause is that `RocmAttentionMetadataBuilder` clears both device and CPU query offsets to prevent an invalid memory access in the prefix prefill kernel. The device offsets must be zeroed for safe graph capture, but the CPU offsets are not used by that kernel and remain shared with subsequent metadata builders. Clearing the CPU copy therefore removes valid batch information those builders need.

## Proposed Fix

Preserve the CPU query offsets while continuing to zero the device offsets.

This keeps the existing prefix prefill capture behavior unchanged while allowing subsequent metadata builders to calculate valid query lengths. The change is scoped to full graph capture through the ROCm metadata builder shared by `ROCM_ATTN` and `ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`.

## Test results

Tested on 4 GPUs, MI325, model -> `EmbeddedLLM/MiniMax-M3-FP8-dynamic`

Before the change, CUDA graph profiling failed:

```text
File "vllm/models/minimax_m3/common/indexer.py", line 317, in build
    assert decode_query_len > 0
AssertionError
EngineCore failed to start.
```

After the change:

```text
Graph capturing finished in 8 secs, took 0.19 GiB
Application startup complete.
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

<details>
<summary>Reproduction command</summary>

```bash
export HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1

vllm serve EmbeddedLLM/MiniMax-M3-FP8-dynamic \
  --served-model-name minimax-m3 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --max-num-seqs 32 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --async-scheduling \
  --tool-call-parser minimax_m3 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --language-model-only \
  --port 8000 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN
```

</details>

nodes.body:
I noticed that the InfX recipe for  [`amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4`](https://huggingface.co/amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4) used trition attention as the attention backend and was curious if they had the same issue as the one my PR is trying to fix and sure enough it does!

Environment:

- Image: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-ac7509e2b1db40fec2f03dde1ed4e9dfdc2338c9`
- ROCm 7.2.3
- vLLM `0.27.2rc1.dev77+gac7509e2b.rocm723`
- AITER `0.1.19`

<details>
<summary>Serving command</summary>

```bash
export VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1
export VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1

vllm serve amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --block-size 128 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --language-model-only \
  --max-model-len 133120 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --max-num-seqs 128 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --async-scheduling \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend aiter \
  --tool-call-parser minimax_m3 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
  --no-enable-log-requests
```
</details>

With my fix the AITER UA backend now completes CUDA graph capture and serves normally. Before the fix, startup failed at `assert decode_query_len > 0`.

## Performance versus `TRITON_ATTN`, averaged over three runs:

| Workload | Metric | Triton | AITER UA | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 60k/600, C16 | Output throughput | 274.75 tok/s | 314.79 tok/s | **+14.57%** |
| 60k/600, C16 | TTFT | 11,807 ms | 9,823 ms | **-16.80%** |
| 60k/600, C16 | TPOT | 38.56 ms | 34.45 ms | **-10.65%** |
| 60k/600, C16 | E2E latency | 34,903 ms | 30,460 ms | **-12.73%** |
| 8k/1k, C64 | Output throughput | 2,374.93 tok/s | 2,391.24 tok/s | **+0.69%** |
| 8k/1k, C64 | TTFT | 4,127 ms | 4,029 ms | **-2.36%** |
| 8k/1k, C64 | TPOT | 22.79 ms | 22.70 ms | **-0.42%** |
| 8k/1k, C64 | E2E latency | 26,898 ms | 26,705 ms | **-0.72%** |


Full GSM8K: 1,319 examples, 5-shot, chat template, few-shot as multiturn, and `max_gen_toks=16384`.

| Filter | Triton | AITER UA | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Flexible extract | 94.01% (1240/1319) | 93.93% (1239/1319) | **-0.08 pp** |
| Strict match | 94.09% (1241/1319) | 94.01% (1240/1319) | **-0.08 pp** |

files.patch:
@@ -103,11 +103,9 @@ def build_for_cudagraph_capture(
         # slow, so here we set it to 1.
         attn_metadata.seq_lens.fill_(1)
 
-        # Here we set the query start locs to 0. This is to
-        # cover up an invalid memory access in the prefix_prefil kernel
-        # that we run into during graph capture (#25985)
+        # Zero device query start locations to avoid invalid memory access in
+        # the prefix prefill kernel during graph capture (#25985).
         common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc.zero_()
-        common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu.zero_()
 
         return attn_metadata
